label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-TP: param = request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to response.sendRedirect(param) without sanitization. Resolved sink value is attacker-controlled user input. The guard checking client IP (10.x.x.x) does not mitigate the vulnerability—it only restricts which clients can exploit it. User-supplied param determines the redirect target, enabling open redirect attacks.

evidence.note: param from user input flows directly to sendRedirect sink without validation
